items.exampleEn: Rice is a staple in many Asian countries.
items.exampleZh: 在許多亞洲國家，米是主食。

items.exampleEn: The machine was built to the customer's exact specifications.
items.exampleZh: 這台機器完全依照客戶的規格製造。

items.exampleEn: These boots are made of durable leather.
items.exampleZh: 這雙靴子是用耐用的皮革做的。

items.exampleEn: A simple mechanism inside the door keeps it closed.
items.exampleZh: 門裡的一個簡單裝置讓它保持關閉。

items.exampleEn: The company announced a one-month suspension of sales of its new phone.
items.exampleZh: 那家公司公告新手機暫停銷售一個月。
items.glossZh: 暫停、中止；停職、懸吊系統

items.exampleEn: Stretching is part of every dancer's daily routine.
items.exampleZh: 伸展是每位舞者每天的例行功課。

items.sentenceEn: This durable plastic can last for decades.
items.sentenceZh: 這種耐用的塑膠可以用上好幾十年。

items.audioEn: The watch stopped because a tiny part of the mechanism broke.
items.audioZh: 這支錶停了，因為機械裝置裡有個小零件壞了。
options: It was left in the sun

items.sentenceEn: Every part must meet the same specifications.
items.sentenceZh: 每個零件都必須符合同樣的規格。

items.sentenceEn: Jeans have become a staple of everyday fashion.
items.sentenceZh: 牛仔褲已經成為日常穿搭的必備單品。

items.stemEn: We need ____ materials that will not break after a few months.
items.stemZh: 我們需要幾個月後也不會壞的耐用材料。

items.stemEn: The clock's ____ is so simple that a child can repair it.
items.stemZh: 這座時鐘的機械裝置簡單到連小孩都會修。

items.passageEn: Our factory makes school backpacks, a staple product that sells well every August. Last year, a big customer sent new specifications: the bags had to be lighter but just as durable. Engineers tested a new closing mechanism and a softer shoulder strap that reduces stretching of the fabric. Because of a quality problem, there was a two-week suspension of production while the line was refurbished. In the end, the new backpacks passed every test in the lab, and the customer was so pleased that it ordered twice as many as before.
items.passageZh: 我們工廠生產學生背包，這是每年八月都很好賣的主力產品。去年，一位大客戶寄來新的規格：背包必須更輕，但要一樣耐用。工程師測試了新的開合裝置，以及能減少布料拉伸的柔軟肩帶。由於一個品質問題，生產線停工兩週進行整修。最後，新背包通過了實驗室的所有測試，客戶非常滿意，訂單是以前的兩倍。

questions.questionZh: 客戶的新規格要求什麼？
options: 背包要有更多顏色可選

questions.questionZh: 生產線為什麼停了兩週？
options: 工廠的工程師們都去休假了
客戶突然取消了所有的訂單

items.promptZh: 很多人跑步前會做一些伸展。
referenceEn: Many people do some stretching before they run.
Before running, a lot of people do some stretching.
rubricZh: stretching 是不可數名詞，表示「伸展」，用法例如 do some stretching、do stretching 等
「跑步前」可寫，例如 before they run、before running 等

items.instructionZh: 用 durable 造一個句子，說說你用了很久、很耐用的一樣東西。
referenceEn: My watch is so durable that it still works after twenty years.
My old suitcase is very durable; it has been to ten countries.
rubricZh: durable 是形容詞，表示「耐用的」（例如 durable shoes、a durable phone 等）
句子要說到你自己的東西

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：題目要「你用了很久的一樣東西」，參考答案 "My grandfather's watch..." 主體是爺爺的錶，不一定是你自己的東西，與評分要點「說到你自己的東西」不一致（§10-①）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 參考答案 1 改成自己的東西 My watch is so durable that it still works after twenty years.；參考答案 2 改 My old suitcase is very durable; it has been to ten countries.（與卡片的靴子錯開）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：作者疑慮回覆：suspension 第一義「暫停、停職」為 C1 最常用義、與短文 suspension of production 一致，可接受；但單字卡例句是運動「禁賽」，與本單元（產品規格、機械）主題不合，譯文「禁賽」也不在釋義中。可考慮第一義寫「暫停、停賽」或例句改其他暫停情境（須與短文情境錯開）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依裁示例句改成合製造單元的「暫停」義：The supplier's problems caused a suspension of deliveries to the factory.；釋義改「暫停、中止；停職、懸吊系統」，干擾項同步改格式

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B：參考答案 2 與卡都是「這雙鞋或靴子很耐用」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改 My old suitcase is very durable; it has been to ten countries.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：「常用 do some stretching」沒有「例如…等」（§11-23）；stretch before running、do stretches 等也應收。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示評分要點統一改「例如…等」：stretching 是不可數名詞，表示「伸展」，用法例如 do some stretching、do stretching 等／「跑步前」可寫，例如 before they run、before running 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：stretching 是不可數名詞，表示「伸展」，用法例如 do some stretching、do stretching 等／「跑步前」可寫，例如 before they run、before running 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長最終複審修正：最終複審 10：suspension 新卡與閱讀都是「出了問題，工廠運作暫停」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 卡改 The company announced a one-month suspension of sales of its new phone.
